heading: Valentine's Day in the Okanagan, 2027
title: Valentine's Day in the Okanagan 2027 | Okanagan Roam
description: Valentine's week 2027 in the Okanagan: a salt-cave chocolate night, ballet, romantic dinners, floating saunas, chocolate shops and a snowcat dinner.
intro: February in the Okanagan suits a slow evening out. This guide gathers date ideas for the week around February 14, 2027: a few events, dinners built for lingering, saunas on the lake, cocktails and chocolate, and a couple of snowy nights up the mountain. For everything else on that month, see our {page:/guides/okanagan-winter-events|winter events guide}.
The picks are spread across the valley, from Enderby and Vernon down to Naramata and Okanagan Falls. Many of these take bookings, so plan ahead and check each listing before you go.

sections.heading: Valentine's week events
sections.lead: These are the dated events that fit a night out for two.

items.name: Valentine’s Day Bliss: Yoga, Sound & Local Chocolate in the Salt Cave
items.text: yoga, sound and local chocolate in the salt cave at Room and Pillar Spa, 6:30 to 7:30 pm. Admission is $55.

items.name: Ballet Kelowna: A Streetcar Named Desire
items.text: at Kelowna Community Theatre, 7:30 pm. Admission is $41.94 to $105.61.

items.name: Come From Away
items.text: dinner and a show at the Actors Studio & Dinner Theatre, running through Valentine's week. Admission is $93 to $100.

sections.heading: Romantic dinners
sections.lead: Small rooms, fireplaces and set menus. For more warm rooms to settle into, see our {page:/guides/cozy-spots-okanagan|cozy spots guide}, and for winery visits this time of year, our {page:/guides/okanagan-winter-wine|winter wine guide}.

items.name: Bistro Lapin Perdu
items.text: a quiet, romantic French bistro inside the historic Naramata Inn, with a garden view. It's a place to linger, course by course.

items.name: HUMO Kelowna
items.text: an intimate tasting menu, and a good pick for a first date or a special occasion. Book ahead and mention any dietary needs when you do.

items.name: Bouchons Bistro
items.text: the owner greets guests in French, and reviewers single out the escargot and duck confit. Book ahead and let the evening unfold slowly.

items.name: Intermezzo Restaurant and Wine Cellar
items.text: elegant Italian fine dining with a wine cellar, and live Spanish guitar on select nights.

items.name: Gerni's Farmhouse
items.text: an adults-only (16+) German-Austrian dining room inside Sparkling Hill Resort, popular with couples.

items.name: Kaze Japanese Restaurant
items.text: a cozy, family-run spot in a converted old home, with a fireplace dining room and a miso ramen reviewers call spectacular.

items.name: The Barn Bistro at See Ya Later Ranch
items.text: the hilltop winery's kitchen runs ticketed Friday chef's dinners through the cooler months, with a surprise menu and a glass of wine. Check the winery's booking page first.

sections.heading: Saunas & warm soaks
sections.lead: A sauna session makes an easy afternoon date before dinner. Our {page:/guides/okanagan-saunas-spas|saunas and spas guide} has more.

items.name: Cleopatra's Rituals Thermal Spa and Steam
items.text: a hot-cold circuit of sauna, steam, thermal showers and a falling-snow room. Book a Thermal Ritual session or reserve the space privately.

items.name: Löyly Floating Sauna
items.text: a Finnish-style cedar sauna at the Downtown Marina, with a lake cold plunge and a warm solarium lounge overlooking Okanagan Lake.

items.name: Shelter Floating Sauna
items.text: a cedar sauna floating at the Lakeside Resort marina. Join a shared session or book the whole sauna privately.

sections.heading: Cocktails, chocolate & dessert
sections.lead: For a drink after dinner, or a box of chocolates to bring home.

items.name: Bernie's Supper Club & Cinema
items.text: a speakeasy-style supper club with an oyster bar and an upstairs theatre for a show after the meal. Book ahead for the theatre.

items.name: Micro Bar + Bites
items.text: a short cocktail list and seasonal small plates in a small, intimate room.

items.name: Wildflower Distilling Co.
items.text: a downtown craft distillery that doubles as an intimate cocktail lounge. Start with a tasting flight.

items.name: Chulo Tapas & Bar
items.text: a micro tapas bar for Spanish and Mediterranean small plates; reviewers single out the roasted duck and the craft cocktails.

items.name: Karat Chocolate
items.text: a downtown pastry boutique that sources its chocolate directly from a Brazilian partner farm, known for showstopping cakes.

items.name: Kin+Pod Chocolate, Ice Cream, and Coffee
items.text: chocolate, ice cream and coffee all made in house, and the owner is happy to let you sample before you choose.

items.name: Accent Chocolate Factory
items.text: handmade chocolates on Main Street since 2000, made with Belgian couverture, plus espresso drinks and tea.

sections.heading: Snowy dates on the mountain
sections.lead: If you'd rather spend the evening in the snow, the ski hills have a few good options. For more winter outings, see our {page:/guides/okanagan-sleigh-rides-dog-sledding|sleigh rides and dog sledding guide}.

items.name: Paradise Camp Snowcat Dinner Tours – SilverStar
items.text: an evening snowcat ride about 8 km through the snowy forest to Paradise Camp, then a candlelit multi-course dinner. Runs select evenings, December to April.

items.name: La Plata
items.text: tapas and cocktails in SilverStar Village, with spruce syrup cocktails, a prickly pear mocktail and a tasting menu.

items.name: 6° Bistro
items.text: an intimate set-menu bistro with a warm outdoor fireplace, fur seating and a tasting menu with vegetarian options.

items.name: The Loose Moose Challenge – February
items.text: a village scavenger hunt. Pick up a card at the Events Tent in the Village Centre from 9 am and return it the next afternoon.
